skill.summary: Guide users to VideoAny Image-to-Video, an uncensored AI video generator with multi-model support.

latestVersion.changelog:
Image-to-Video Skill v1.0.0

- Initial release with guidance for animating images using the VideoAny image-to-video platform.
- Lists all supported models (VideoAny, Grok Imagine, Wan 2.5, LTX, Seedance 1.5/2.0, Kling3, Vidu Q3, Veo3/3.1, Sora2).
- Provides clear usage instructions for the CLI helper script and copy-ready prompts for user workflows.
- No third-party Python dependencies required.
- Agent guidance focused on directing users to the VideoAny platform for uncensored multi-model video generation.
